CSCA Chemistry Syllabus & Key Chapters/CSCA 化学考试大纲与核心考点

01

Atomic & Molecular Structure: Quantum numbers, electron configuration, periodic trends (electronegativity, ionization energy), chemical bonding (ionic, covalent, metallic).

原子与分子结构：量子数、核外电子排布、周期律（电负性、电离能）、化学键类型（离子键、共价键、金属键）。

02

Physical Chemistry: Chemical stoichiometry, gas behavior, chemical kinetics (rate laws, activation energy), chemical equilibrium ($K_c, K_p$), thermodynamics (enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs free energy).

物理化学：化学计量计算、理想与实际气体、化学反应动力学（速率方程、活化能）、化学平衡常数（$K_c, K_p$）、化学热力学（焓变、熵变、吉布斯自由能）。

03

Inorganic Chemistry: Properties of main-group elements, coordination compounds, transition metal properties.

无机化学：主族元素性质递变规律、配位化合物基础、过渡金属特征性质。

04

Organic Chemistry: Nomenclature, functional groups (alcohols, aldehydes, carboxylic acids, esters), common organic reaction mechanisms (addition, substitution, elimination).

有机化学：有机物命名法、经典官能团性质（醇、醛、羧酸、酯）、常见反应机理（加成、取代、消去反应）。

CSCA Chemistry Study Guide/CSCA 化学如何高效备考与复习

Master chemical stoichiometry and dimensional analysis to balance complex gas equilibrium formulas.

熟练掌握化学计量计算与量纲分析，以应对复杂的气体平衡与浓度计算题。

Draw organic molecular structures and functional groups using the stylus pad to memorize synthesis paths.

利用画板亲手绘制有机分子结构式，分类整理官能团之间的转化关系，以便于记忆合成路径。

Study acid-base chemistry and titration concepts; practice calculating pH values of strong/weak electrolytes.

深入研究酸碱电离与中和滴定概念，熟练掌握强弱电解质溶液 pH 值的计算方法。

Familiarize yourself with the periodic table layout and periodic property trends.

熟悉周期表排布，重点记忆各周期、各族元素性质的周期性变化规律。

Frequently Asked Questions

All you need to know about the CSCA assessment & prep

Are periodic tables provided during the exam?考试过程中会提供元素周期表吗？expand_more

Yes, a standard periodic table showing atomic number and atomic mass is usually built directly into the digital workspace.

是的，包含原子序数和相对原子质量的标准元素周期表通常会直接内置在数字化模考工作区中。

What is the weight of Organic Chemistry?有机化学在考试中占比如何？expand_more

Organic Chemistry usually accounts for 25-30% of the chemistry exam, focusing on functional group properties and synthetic reaction paths.

有机化学通常占化学考试总分的 25-30% 左右，主要考查官能团性质、反应机理以及简单的合成路线。

How to prepare for physical chemistry?如何备考物理化学（物化）部分？expand_more

Focus on understanding gas laws, chemical equilibrium constants, and enthalpy changes. Practice numerical conversions carefully.

重点理解理想气体状态方程、化学平衡常数及焓变计算，平时多做涉及热力学与动力学计算的真题训练。

mainEntity.name: What is the CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) is the standardized STEM competency assessment used by top Chinese universities and CSC Government Scholarship committees to evaluate international undergraduate candidates in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Academic Chinese.

mainEntity.name: How to prepare for the CSCA exam online?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for the CSCA exam, students should use CSCA Space (csca.space) for adaptive mock test simulations, past paper questions, bilingual terminology drills, formula sheets, and step-by-step video explainers aligned with the official CSCA syllabus.

mainEntity.name: What subjects are tested in the CSCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: The CSCA exam tests four core disciplines: Mathematics (Algebra, Calculus, Analytical Geometry), Physics (Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Waves), Chemistry (Physical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Stoichiometry), and Academic Chinese.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find CSCA past papers and practice questions?

acceptedAnswer.text: CSCA Space provides verified CSCA mock exams, diagnostic assessments, and curated past questions with comprehensive step-by-step pedagogical walkthroughs at https://csca.space.

mainEntity.name: How does CSCA Space help international students prepare for the CSCA?

acceptedAnswer.text: CSCA Space provides 100% syllabus-aligned interactive practice, bilingual English and Chinese STEM explanations, full diagnostic scoring, and adaptive mock test simulations designed specifically for international university admissions in China.

mainEntity.name: What is a competitive score on the CSCA for CSC scholarships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Candidates scoring in the 80th percentile and above are highly competitive for full Chinese Government Scholarships (CSC Type A & Type B) and direct admission into top C9 league universities.
